comments.mergedPostDetails:
So... I don't know about you but, because I had only spent the game in desktop mode for about 2,500+ hours until I got my VR recently from my family on my birthday,
this issue had never occurred, because the menus would always be centered and all lined up in the screen so everything was orderly, but now however since I'm in VR now this issue has occurred.

...(bringing up the issue)
The issue is related to the -menus- that shows up when you click on [World], [Avatar], [Social], and [System] the big -billboard-like-menu- that pops up after clicking either of those,
the angle in which this -menu- appears in that of looking at a piece of paper on a desk and far too close to the user, for those who sit, lay down, or relax this can be an bigger issue,
not going to mention that an headset or headphones one may have could potentially fall off more easily since the angle to look at your menu is so low, and could cause more discomfort with the VR

...(resolving the issue)
The possibilities solution's is to have either a slider or a dome like slider for VR users to be able to change the location and / or angle of the menu,
another alternative is to have an options menu showing a preview image of a dot representing the VR user and a line representing the menu that you can 
change the angle of when appearing after clicking on either of the buttons previously mentioned any of these options would be stimulated and applied the same way that you would with the camera system,
but the grabbing part would be either the slider or the Dome slider previously mentioned off to the side of the menu in order to have this functionable.

-ScrinnodStudios
comments.mergedPostTitle: It's Too Low & Too Close! (VR Menus)
comments.value: So true, I sit a lot IRL if in VRC and it is really hard to see the entire menu. I tend to lean forward when I open them and then lean back so they are further away. Why do they have to bee so close? I hope the next gen UI gets a few sliders or can be grabbed like the oculus menus.

comments.value:
If you pay close attention to other VRSNSs and their creations, you will be surprised to find that no service is facing this problem.
When started VR, there were too few people who actually expected to use it lying down.
The oculus Menu has been improved to some extent, but it still gets in the way when using it lying down, and you can't put the display anywhere you want without using a special app.
Maybe even being able to "grab" the menu and put it wherever you want would be really cool!

In October we released the UI 2.0 update, which includes a movable main menu. https://hello.vrchat.com/blog/main-menu-update-live

You can see a preview of the movable main menu here:

https://ask.vrchat.com/t/developer-update-29-july-2022/10900

You can move the menu above your head and lock it in place. So even if you're lying down horizontally, the menu remains accessible.

Please let us know what you think, or if you have any additional feedback!

details:
Thank you for all your development work.
　I have a suggestion for the display angle of the so-called 'big menu', which is not Launchpad.
　I consider Launchpad to be a very nice feature that can be viewed from any angle, even if I'm lying down.
　However, the 'big menu' can only be viewed from an upright perspective, and if I was to lie down, I would have to wake up to view the 'big menu', which is a very big problem for my friends and me.
　So, I have a suggestion: could it be changed to follow hands or follow 
a viewpoint, like the Launchpad?
　Off course, I would be very grateful if you could develop a new UI, but even if not, I think just being able to change the display angle flexibly would greatly improve usability.
　Please consider this.
title: Flexible angle for large menus
